name: Customer Export CSV for Woo
author: emilion.co.il

sections.description:
This plugin allows WooCommerce store owners to export their customer data to CSV files. The plugin offers advanced filtering options and field selection for export, enabling you to get exactly the information you need.

Key Features:
* Export customers to CSV
* Select fields for export
* Filter by registration date
* Filter by total purchase amount
* Filter by number of orders
* Full UTF-8 support

Donations

If you enjoy this plugin, please consider contributing to its development:

https://www.paypal.com/donate/?hosted_button_id=W4G4NUHRJXK5N
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to ‘WooCommerce’ > ‘Export Customers’ to use the plugin.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin support languages other than English?

Currently, the plugin supports English and Hebrew. We are considering adding support for additional languages in the future.

Can I add custom fields to the export?

This version of the plugin does not support custom fields. We are considering adding this feature in future updates.
